why: The data table is the headline item: fixed layout tiers and derived phone cards replace argo's hand layouts, and the owner accepts them before freeze (docs/v3/concepts/data-table.md section 9 S3, S4).
what: tools/spikes/table-fit/** and docs/v3/spikes/table-fit.md. Built on the `./table` parts of table-t2 (packages/basalt-ui/src/table, read only). Read argo's ledger, text-heavy and numeric tables, `catalog-table` (14 columns), `sparkline-grid-chart`, the 8 `renderCard` sites (BookingRow, CatalogCard, slots-list, spending, net-worth, recurring x3) and the `tax` queue; reproduce their column kinds, widths and text lengths with synthetic rows (argo's rows are personal data).
must_not_touch: consumer repos (scratch copies live in the OS temp dir)
contract: docs/v3/concepts/data-table.md sections 5, 9, 13 (E1) are frozen; a last-resort typed box slot is an amendment request only. S5 bytes are v3-spike-table-bytes.
change: S3: kind widths against today's auto layout at 500, 800, 1000, 1200, 1800 px, plus `spark`; assert in Chrome that no non-`scroll` cell has scrollWidth above clientWidth. S4: port the 8 `renderCard` sites and the `tax` queue to derived cards (expected: 6 fit title, value, meta, `edit`; catalog and slots-list keep a meta run and move the rest to the sheet).
commits: One non-package commit `chore: spike table-fit harness and verdict`, empty scope, no attribution.
proof: Shots per table and card site at 1800x1200 and 390x844 (S3 also 500, 800, 1000, 1200), dark and light, under tools/spikes/table-fit/shots/, synthetic rows, each <= 250 KB; at most 3 rounds.
acceptance: run.ts JSON has `s3.overflowOutsideScroll` (0 required), `s4.fitCount` (of 9 sites) and `s4.needsSlot` (site names)
`bun tools/spikes/table-fit/run.ts` exits 0, prints one JSON object with the keys above (0 = harness ran, not hypothesis held)
docs/v3/spikes/table-fit.md has headings Question, Method, Measurements, Verdict, Then, Affects and the `verdict` lines
out_of_scope: Table features; the contract slots; editing argo; bytes and perf.
envelope: Harness: tools/spikes/<dir>/ has its own package.json (exact pins); bun.lock and node_modules gitignored there (must_not_touch package.json and bun.lock = repo root only). Passes root oxlint; no *.test.* files; Chrome via the playwright-core pattern of packages/basalt-ui/tests/layout/harness.ts; docs/v3 on master before filing; synthetic data only, private repos as counts and hashed ids.
verdict: Lines `S3: PASS|REFUTED` and `S4: PASS|REFUTED` (machine) plus `Owner S3: pending` and `Owner S4: pending`: the owner accepts at 1800x1200 and 390x844, never self-accepted; v3-verdict-table carries it with these shots. S3 REFUTED on any `overflowOutsideScroll` above 0 (then a `content` width option on text and entity). S4 REFUTED when a site needs a named slot (listed). `Verdict: PASS` iff both PASS; run.ts `verdict` the same.
